subject: general
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution specifically mentions, "The official language of the Union shall be Hindi in Devanagari script?"
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 343(1)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 343(1)** of the Indian Constitution specifies that "The official language of the Union shall be Hindi in Devanagari script."
 
• The Constitution initially provided for the continued use of English for all official purposes of the Union for a period of 15 years from its commencement, after which Hindi was to become the sole official language.
 
• However, due to the linguistic diversity of India, the Official Languages Act, 1963 was passed, allowing for the continued use of English alongside Hindi for official purposes.
 
• This provision highlights the importance of Hindi as the official language, while also recognizing the practical need for English in official communication.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitution of India** was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949** and **came into effect on 26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written** constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• The **Official Languages Act, 1963** plays a crucial role in the continued use of English for official purposes, reflecting the linguistic diversity of the nation.
